picks.file: Дніпрельстан Кичкаський міст Листівка Серія 3 номер 34.jpg
picks.what: The Kichkas Bridge over the Dnieper, postcard
picks.why: the town’s best-known landmark before the dam, the great arch railroad bridge at Kichkas; blank sky of the card trimmed

gaps: P0–P4: nothing usable (Norblin costume prints, a manor in Bilenke, single railroad-station buildings, a synagogue); P6: kept the 2021 Khortytsia photo
notes: #12 is dated ‘before 1928’; it is from a Soviet Ukrainian postcard series (Ukrholovlit, 1922 or later) on the Dniprelstan project, so 1920s. #11 (Luftwaffe 1941–42) is a vertical map-like aerial of the damaged dam; skipped. #7 Aleksandrovsk station (1880) is a single building.
